topic: The Riemann Zeta Function: Bridging Arithmetic and Geometry
target_audience: Undergraduate students with a background in basic calculus

sections.title: The Infinite Sum: Intuitive Foundation
lecture_lines: The Zeta function sums 1 over n to the s.
For s greater than 1, it converges beautifully.
Imagine a squirrel gathering acorns forever.
animations: Create title 'The Infinite Sum' in white (#FFFFFF) at center.
Animate a series of [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/acorn.svg] terms adding up to create a shape.
Highlight the sum with a yellow (#FFFF00) glow, featuring a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/squirrel.svg] appearing nearby.

sections.title: Analytic Continuation: Looking Beyond the Horizon
lecture_lines: The sum diverges when s is 1 or less.
Analytic continuation extends the function's reach.
Think of it as mapping unknown territory.
animations: Show the function domain extending beyond original bounds.
Reveal the extended region in a soft green (#90EE90) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/globe.svg].

sections.title: The Critical Strip and the Hypothesis
lecture_lines: The critical strip lies between 0 and 1.
The Riemann Hypothesis targets the critical line.
It predicts where all non-trivial zeros land.
animations: Render the 'Critical Strip' using a light purple (#E6E6FA) rectangle.
Place points (zeros) within the strip using red (#FF0000).
Emphasize the line x=1/2 with a bold white (#FFFFFF) stroke.

sections.title: The Bridge: Primes and Zeros
lecture_lines: Euler links Zeta to the prime numbers.
Primes behave like a chaotic swarm.
Zeta zeros reveal the underlying prime rhythm.
animations: Connect prime numbers on left to zeros on right using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/swarm.svg].
Draw a dashed path in orange (#FFA500) between elements.
Pulse the connection to signify resonance.

sections.title: Summary and Implications
lecture_lines: Zeta bridges arithmetic and complex geometry.
Solving it unlocks prime number secrets.
A master key for mathematical structure.
animations: List three core concepts in light gray (#D3D3D3).
